title: Training Questions and Answers: Renewal Share on the Final Electricity Overage Charge
content:
# Final Electricity Renewal Share — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Rule.** A final electricity renewal share applies to the final electricity overage line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account: **0.94** when the lease has at least 3 renewal rent changes on record, **0.97** when it has at least 1 but fewer than 3, and the **whole charge** otherwise. The share multiplies the line's charge, which is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Questions answered

**Where are renewal rent changes recorded?** On the Lease Term Agreement records of the lease, as rent changes with the reason renewal.

**One renewal?** 0.97.

**Four renewals?** 0.94.

**No renewal?** The whole charge.

*Worked case (hypothetical charge of $25.50):* 0.94 gives $23.97; 0.97 gives $24.735, which is $24.74 at the end.
